referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Café Carmellini website in New York, New York uses ornate full-screen dining-room image with quiet booking utility. Navigation is small over-image reservation control and folded menu. Its page moves through grand-room opening, brief dining introduction, framed split menu chapter, framed split private-event chapter, fine-pattern footer, with two decisive routes for menu and private-event enquiry. high-key plated dishes cropped inside symmetrical navy frames. Transferable mechanics are ornate room hero, navy bordered splits, script labels. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
